content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone have recommendations for controlling the speed of a small 220V/50Hz/70W fan using a 0-10V analog output? I am not looking for frequency converters—perhaps something like a dimmer or similar method?

Dear forum member, To regulate an analog output (0-10V), you can use the [product_name] controller along with the [product_name] analog output module, which provides two 0-10V outputs. With [product_name] configuration software, you can design your own application and utilize available analog function blocks for your specific requirements. I have extensive experience with these analog modules. If you need further assistance, feel free to share more details about your motor and intended application. Alternatively, you can email me at [user_name]@[company_name].es I am from Spain. Best regards, [user_name]
